the State of Uttarakhand/respondent no.2.
4. Learned counsel for the respondents￾contemnors supplied the instructions dated 
21.07.2026 as well as the e-mail dated 21.07.2026, 
and the same are taken on record. On instructions, 
it is submitted that order passed by Writ Court in 
WPMS No.1807 of 2026 (Ranipur Private 
Industrial Training Institute vs. Union of India & 
others) has been complied with. Out of six students, 
four students came to the College and participated in 
the practical examination. So far as the other 
two students are concerned, since they could not 
appear in the practical examination, arrangements 
have been made for them to participate in the 
supplementary practical examination as and when  UKHC010112832026

such examination is held. Thus, he submits that the 
order has already been complied with.
5. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners 
does not dispute the said contention raised on behalf 
of the respondents-contemnors. He also admits that 
the order has now been complied with.
6. Accordingly, the contempt petition is hereby 
closed. 
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
